main_idea: GRPO training raised Qwen3.8-27B’s DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%.
ideas: GRPO training improved DeepSWE pass@1 by 11.3 points.
Tasks came from private codebases and covered five languages.
GRPO used eight attempts per task over 15 updates.
summary: The chart communicates the gain clearly, but the branding, long headline, supporting metrics, methodology cards, and footer compete for attention.
